game_title: Mixed Type Oracle – Fire Shrine Streak
game_concept: A card battler set in Mt. Pyre – Fire Shrine, an ancient fire shrine: the ash ranger must handle cinder bats while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Mixed Type Oracle: Predict the result or error of mixed-type expressions before cinder bats spring the trap.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Fire Shrine: an ancient fire shrine
core_gameplay_loop: In Fire Shrine, repeat each round: Predict the result or error of mixed-type expressions before cinder bats spring the trap. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the predictions value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Chain 12 consecutive correct decisions about predictions to power up the ash ranger and open the obsidian gate.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 6 (applied tier): Mixed Type Oracle
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
